name: Roasted Miso-Hoisin Broccoli, Asparagus & Veggie Sausage over Rice
instructions: Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a medium saucepan. Add water and salt, then bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.

Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash, dry, peel, and mince ginger. Place in a medium bowl along with hoisin sauce, miso paste, oil, and spices. Stir to combine the sauce.

Wash, dry, and snap (or cut) off woody ends of the asparagus. Add to the bowl with the sauce, along with the broccoli, and stir to coat. Transfer veggies to a large baking sheet pan and spread out in an even layer.
Place veggies in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake until just tender, 8-10 minutes.
When the veggies are done, remove from the oven and stir. Add sausages to the baking sheet, nestling them into the veggies. Drizzle sausages with additional oil.
Return baking sheet to the oven and continue to bake until sausages are warmed through, about 5 minutes. Remove from oven.
Transfer sausages to a cutting board and slice crosswise into pieces.
To serve, divide rice, sausage, and veggies between plates or bowls. Enjoy!
author: Mealime
